meta.name: offensive-z-wave
meta.description: Z-Wave attack methodology — sniffing with Z-Force / EZ-Wave / RTL-SDR + ZniffMobile, S0 (legacy) network-key derivation flaw and key reuse, S2 (modern) ECDH commissioning analysis, replay/injection on unauthenticated nodes, default-key brute-force on test deployments, and home-automation hub pivots. Use when targeting Z-Wave smart home devices (door locks, sensors, garage controllers) — common in mid-2010s smart home deployments still in production.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 能指导你嗅探 Z-Wave 通信、破解 S0 网络密钥、重放未认证设备指令，以及分析 S2 实现漏洞。
howto.when: 当你需要评估 Z-Wave 智能家居设备（如门锁、传感器、车库控制器）的安全性时触发，尤其是针对 2010 年代中期仍在使用的旧设备。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can guide you through sniffing Z-Wave traffic, cracking S0 network keys, replaying commands to unauthenticated nodes, and analyzing S2 implementation flaws.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you need to assess the security of Z-Wave smart home devices (door locks, sensors, garage controllers), especially older mid-2010s deployments still in production.

say_en.text: Help me sniff the S0 network key of a Z-Wave door lock.
say_en.note: Claude will guide you to capture the key exchange frame.

say_en.text: How to replay commands to an unauthenticated Z-Wave switch?
say_en.note: Claude will provide steps using scapy-zwave to send crafted frames.

say_en.text: Analyze this S2 door lock's ECDH implementation for flaws.
say_en.note: Claude will list common S2 attack surfaces like DSK leakage or firmware bugs.
